item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - Usher - The Truth Tour - Live in Atlanta 2005
item.description:
Hey, Everybody!
I got back into Usher's music recently and yet again (just like back in the '00s, when he was in the mainstream and I was quite little), I'm amazed by Usher's talent, both vocally and when it comes to dancing. :O
That's also why I shyly wish I could see his 2005 Atlanta gig (from the "Confessions" era) in full and in good quality.
I know it's already released on DVD, but since I've read that it's a 3-disc package, it might be quite hard to find or afford for me (just in case, I'm sorry)... What also makes things difficult is that everything that I tried to watch online from this gig is either blurry, taken down, or parts of the show are missing (for example, I remember that a very long time ago, on YouTube, there was a video - seemingly from this show - where Usher's on-stage Band was introduced by him [from off-stage]. However, I can't seem to find & watch that part online again - just the introductions of the Dancers, in the same style).
With a quiet hope that this is allowed, could Anybody share Usher's full Atlanta concert on this forum (for example, in MP4), pleeeeease?...
Thank You veeeeery much in advance, best regards, take care and Happy New Year, Everyone! -
Wiktor from Poland
item.author: wikorybek
